name: shopify-admin-mcp
description: MCP server for the Shopify Admin GraphQL API using asset-backed code mode

SHOPIFY_SHOP_DOMAIN.description: Your Shopify store domain, for example store-name.myshopify.com

SHOPIFY_ADMIN_API_VERSION.description: The Shopify Admin API version to call, for example 2026-04

SHOPIFY_ADMIN_ACCESS_TOKEN.description: A Shopify Admin API access token with the scopes required by your MCP usage

MCP_API_KEY.description: Optional API key required to access the /mcp endpoint

scripts.deploy: npm run build:search-assets && wrangler deploy --env staging
scripts.deploy:prod: npm run build:search-assets && wrangler deploy --env production
scripts.check: npm run build:search-assets && npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test
